docs.title: ChatTask 快速接入
docs.text: 以下任务模板能力从 ChatTask 0.1.0 开始提供；历史 PyPI 0.0.2 仅为命令行骨架，不具备这些接口。安装前请核对 PyPI 的实际版本。原有整数统计与持续 Shell 实验仍可在网页主导航中使用。

docs.title: 架构与前置条件
docs.text:
登录网页 → ChatTask 模板/私有运行记录 → ChatPyPI 元数据工具
                                  └→ OpenSandbox → 跟踪源码测试、构建、检查
明确批准 → ChatGH/GitHub 已合并 PR 与检查 → 标签 → 既有 OIDC 发布工作流

准备现有 OpenSandbox 控制面与 Docker、固定站点账号、发布版 ChatPyPI 服务、原生 ChatAuth 访问令牌，以及已有 PyPI ChatEnv 命名 profile。安装、服务部署、令牌签发与更新属于运行方，不由 ChatTask 自动完成。单个 Sandbox 仍受 600 秒底层 TTL、1 CPU、512 MiB、PIDs 128、回环端口和零宿主挂载约束；项目构建/测试代码只在其中执行。

docs.title: 安装候选和设置
docs.text:
python -m pip install -e '.[web]'
chattask --tree
chattask paths --json-output

建立 ChatTask ChatEnv 命名 profile，例如 site，填入占位值对应的实际配置：

CHATTASK_SANDBOX_ENDPOINT=http://127.0.0.1:8080
CHATTASK_SANDBOX_API_KEY=<existing-control-plane-key>
CHATTASK_IMAGE=python:3.10-slim
CHATTASK_WEB_ORIGIN=https://task.example.test
CHATTASK_LOGIN_USERNAME=<site-account>
CHATTASK_LOGIN_PASSWORD=<site-password>
CHATTASK_TOOL_PROFILE=task-tools

CHATTASK_TOOL_PROFILE 只是已有 PyPI 命名 profile 的指针。该 profile 由 ChatPyPI 的 load_pypi_env_profile 读取，应在 PyPI ChatEnv 命名空间中包含 CHATPYPI_MODE=service、CHATPYPI_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:10255 和 CHATPYPI_AUTH_PROFILE=task-pypi。ChatTask 不复制 URL 或 token 字段；调用时通过原生 TokenStore().read('ChatAuth', profile) 获取访问令牌。初始服务只允许元数据探测，不通过 ChatPyPI 上传包。所有示例值均为占位值，不能写入源码或日志。

服务器管理员登记干净的受信 Git 根目录，浏览器没有提交路径或 URL 的接口：

chattask repository register --id demo --path /srv/managed/demo --github-repo owner/demo --default-branch main --package-name demo
chattask serve --env-profile site --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000

仓库运行时再次检查干净状态，并绑定 HEAD 与树。只归档跟踪源码；归档直接从固定 Git blob 重建，不受 export-ignore/export-subst 影响；拒绝符号链接、子模块、私密配置和超出大小上限的归档。安装依赖发生于 Sandbox 内，默认只使用公共 PyPI，设置有限重试、命令与总时限；不传递宿主代理或供应方凭据。网络不稳定时，可由可信操作员提供与工作负载Python小版本和架构匹配的公共依赖 deps/ tar.gz 归档：在ChatTask profile同时设置 CHATTASK_PUBLIC_DEPS_PATH（绝对路径）与 CHATTASK_PUBLIC_DEPS_SHA256。启动时会核对摘要/大小和成员安全，仅把公开依赖送入Sandbox；此模式项目安装使用 --no-index，缺依赖会失败，不会误报测试成功。登录、Cookie、Origin 和 CSRF 由 ChatLogin 处理。

docs.title: 网页流程
docs.text:
选择模板、仓库、目标版本；可选填测试 extras（如 web,dev）和已合并 PR 编号，然后点击“创建并执行预检”。默认只预检。内置模板依次进行 pkg_probe、测试、wheel/sdist 构建、Twine 检查；探测退出码 1 可代表名称已占用，仍显示真实回执。每一步的退出码和日志、产物大小与 SHA256、Sandbox ID/清理证据会保存在私有运行记录中。刷新页面可从历史重连；浏览器断开不会取消运行。取消请求在步骤边界生效，且清理核验后才显示“已取消”。

自定义模板可从内置模板选取声明式步骤、测试方式和说明并保存新修订，不接受任意宿主命令。只有通过测试、构建、检查并产生两个真实产物的运行可以进入发布批准。批准页要求手工输入准确的 TAG owner/demo v1.2.3 形式的确认文字，并核对绑定的仓库、版本、源码提交、源码树与 PR。后端再次验证已合并 PR 的源码树、精确 test CI/CI工作流、合版树与预检树一致、默认分支和标签目标。写入不确定时先查询稳定标签目标，绝不盲目重试。已核验的标签仍标记为“等待 OIDC 工作流和 PyPI 产物验证”，不会被称为已发布。

docs.title: HTTP 合约
docs.text:
私有 /api/* 路由均需登录；写操作还需同源 Origin 与 X-CSRF-Token。GET /health 仅证明 HTTP 包身份和存活，不代表执行通过。

方法 路径 作用 GET / POST /api/templates 列出或创建声明式模板 PUT /api/templates/{id} 写入新修订，原修订运行不变 GET /api/templates/{id}/revisions[/{revision}] 查询不可变历史修订 GET /api/repositories 列出已登记仓库 ID 与公开元数据，不返回宿主路径 POST / GET /api/runs 以稳定 request_id 幂等创建预检 / 查询本人历史 GET /api/runs/{id} 本人运行、步骤、清理与发布状态 POST /api/runs/{id}/cancel 请求合作式取消 POST /api/runs/{id}/approve 按精确目标批准创建标签 GET /api/runs/{id}/artifacts/{name} 摘要复核后的二进制下载 GET /api/tool-connections/status 脱敏的连接可用性

旧 /api/tasks 和 /api/sessions 路由仍在。运行在 $CHATARCH_HOME/chattask 下使用同 UID 私有目录和原子 JSON/产物文件；该信任模型不是多租户数据库。重启会把未完成或写入中的运行标记为中断，要求人工核对真实 Sandbox/远端目标，不自动重放。登录会话和持续 Shell 不跨重启恢复。

docs.title: 能力地图
docs.text:
能力 当前实现 边界 模板与仓库 内置 Python 发布模板、自定义声明式修订、CLI 登记受信 Git 根 网页不能提交路径/URL/任意宿主命令；脏源与跟踪的私密配置被拒绝 持久运行 私有原子 JSON、幂等请求 ID、所有者绑定、步骤回执、重启标记 同 UID 信任；中断不自动重放；不是分布式队列 长期 Task 候选 稳定身份、逐轮历史、单写者 worker、受限检查点和原生会话接续 阶段边界暂停、失败需人工核对；生产部署须单独验收 规范化任务候选 创建即初始化任务包、CAS 修订/逐轮冻结、私有导入/复用/导出、可观察 ATIF 原生 checkpoint 不进入复用单元；不倒填旧数据，不自动公开 独立验证候选 持久验证队列、新 Sandbox、逐项 checks/rubric、人工决定分离 缺依赖、缺项、错误和清理未知不算通过；模型评审非客观真值 Task Template 候选 固定方法/验收+实例参数，Python 发版复用原发布流程与阶段记录 资源引用不是凭据、当前可用性或发布授权；生产与真实模型另验 研究轮次候选 可选自动检索 arXiv 摘要或使用已核验来源；原生 Codex 生成自包含 TeX，受信 worker 发布原 Overleaf 并回读 PDF/源码 自动检索不读全文、不保证相关性；原服务由运维配置，未知写入显式同操作核对 Sandbox 预检 跟踪源码归档、真实测试/构建/Twine 检查、wheel/sdist 读回与 SHA256、销毁核验 项目代码仅在 Sandbox；600 秒后端 TTL，步骤与总时限有限 ChatPyPI 工具 复用 PyPI 命名配置及 ChatAuth TokenStore；有限制、无重定向的异步 REST 初始只调用 pkg_probe；退出码 1 可以是名称已占用，不是 HTTP 故障 发布批准 精确目标确认、预检提交/树、已合并 PR 的精确 test CI/CI工作流、合版树与预检树一致、默认分支/标签目标核验 创建标签后只标为等待 OIDC/PyPI 验证，不声称已发布；未知写入须核对 网页 ChatLogin/Origin/CSRF、进度/历史/取消/摘要下载、Sandbox 实验主导航 失效登录清空受保护状态；暂时失败保留过期视图提示 材料分析 受信 Workspace 草稿、显式确认、真实模型 Run 和只读报告 仅已提供资料，无工具/宿主文件权限；报告不等于原建议完成 旧 Sandbox 实验 固定整数统计与持续 Shell、显式回收 Shell 与登录会话不跨重启恢复

普通 Docker/runc 不等于强对抗隔离。真实部署、供应方与浏览器验收在源码测试之外。

docs.title: 通用任务
docs.text:
chattask run --instructions-file task.txt --image-profile python-package --request-id task-001 -e site --json-output

以下来自候选版 chattask --tree 的实际注册命令。

chattask
├── --help  # Show this message and exit.
├── --version  # Show the version and exit.
├── --tree  # Print the registered CLI tree and exit.
├── --tree-brief  # Print the registered CLI tree without parameter signatures and exit.
├── package  # Inspect and run the versioned Python package template.
│   ├── confirm [--id DRAFT-ID] [--revision REVISION] [--preview-sha256 PREVIEW-SHA256] [--confirmation CONFIRMATION] [--request-id REQUEST-ID] [--env-profile ENV-PROFILE]  # Submit the exact verified preview and wait for its publish task.
│   ├── draft-create [--spec-file SPEC-FILE] [--request-id REQUEST-ID]  # Create an owner-bound draft in the private ChatTask store.
│   ├── draft-show [--id DRAFT-ID]  # Read a draft and its verified preparation preview.
│   ├── plan [--spec-file SPEC-FILE]  # Validate a JSON spec and show exact prepare policy/instructions without executing.
│   ├── prepare [--id DRAFT-ID] [--revision REVISION] [--image-profile IMAGE-PROFILE] [--request-id REQUEST-ID] [--env-profile ENV-PROFILE]  # Run and verify the read-only Sandbox preflight for a saved draft.
│   └── schema  # Print the channel-neutral package form schema.
├── paths [--json-output]  # Resolve ChatArch-contained state paths without creating them.
├── repository  # Manage trusted local source roots for template runs.
│   └── register [--id REPO-ID] [--path PATH] [--github-repo GITHUB-REPO] [--default-branch DEFAULT-BRANCH] [--package-name PACKAGE-NAME]  # Register an operator-trusted Git root; browser users cannot supply paths.
├── run [INSTRUCTIONS] [--instructions-file INSTRUCTIONS-FILE] [--image-profile IMAGE-PROFILE] [--request-id REQUEST-ID] [--input-task-id INPUT-TASK-ID] [--env-profile ENV-PROFILE] [--json-output]  # Run a task using Codex inside an ephemeral Sandbox and return its result.
├── serve [--host HOST] [--port PORT] [--env-profile ENV-PROFILE]  # Serve the authenticated Task/Sandbox browser and API from this package.
├── task  # Control private long-term Tasks; rounds execute in a separate worker.
│   ├── complete <TASK-ID> [--request-id REQUEST-ID] [--owner OWNER] [--env-profile ENV-PROFILE]  # Mark an inactive long-term Task complete; history remains available.
│   ├── create [INSTRUCTIONS] [--definition-dir DEFINITION-DIR] [--image-profile IMAGE-PROFILE] [--workflow WORKFLOW] [--sources-file SOURCES-FILE] [--request-id REQUEST-ID] [--owner OWNER] [--env-profile ENV-PROFILE]  # Queue the first round of a long-term Task.
│   ├── evaluate <TASK-ID> <RUN-ID> [--request-id REQUEST-ID] [--owner OWNER] [--env-profile ENV-PROFILE]  # Request independent verification; unavailable is never a passing score.
│   ├── evaluations <TASK-ID> <RUN-ID> [--owner OWNER] [--env-profile ENV-PROFILE]  # Read persisted evaluation history for one exact round.
│   ├── list [--owner OWNER] [--env-profile ENV-PROFILE]  # List Tasks visible to a trusted local principal.
│   ├── package  # Initialize, validate, version, export and reuse portable task definitions.
│   │   ├── export <TASK-ID> [--revision REVISION] [--output OUTPUT] [--owner OWNER] [--env-profile ENV-PROFILE]  # Export a real definition ZIP, excluding session state and credentials.
│   │   ├── init <DIRECTORY> <INSTRUCTIONS> [--image IMAGE]  # Create a new task.toml, instruction.md and verifier draft without model calls.
│   │   ├── reuse <TASK-ID> [--request-id REQUEST-ID] [--owner OWNER] [--env-profile ENV-PROFILE]  # Create and queue a new private Task without inheriting review or grants.
│   │   ├── revise <TASK-ID> [--definition-dir DEFINITION-DIR] [--expected-revision EXPECTED-REVISION] [--request-id REQUEST-ID] [--owner OWNER] [--env-profile ENV-PROFILE]  # Publish a CAS-checked definition revision without rewriting old rounds.
│   │   ├── show <TASK-ID> [--revision REVISION] [--owner OWNER] [--env-profile ENV-PROFILE]  # Read the selected immutable definition visible to this principal.
│   │   └── validate <DIRECTORY> [--official]  # Validate the supported file contract; does not execute a task or verifier.
│   ├── pause <TASK-ID> [--request-id REQUEST-ID] [--owner OWNER] [--env-profile ENV-PROFILE]  # Pause queued work now or request a cooperative end-of-round pause.
│   ├── reconcile-research <TASK-ID> [--request-id REQUEST-ID] [--acknowledge-unknown] [--owner OWNER] [--env-profile ENV-PROFILE]  # Queue explicit same-round Research readback/reconciliation.
│   ├── resume <TASK-ID> <INSTRUCTIONS> [--request-id REQUEST-ID] [--acknowledge-unknown] [--sources-file SOURCES-FILE] [--owner OWNER] [--env-profile ENV-PROFILE]  # Queue an explicit new native Codex round from a verified checkpoint.
│   ├── review <TASK-ID> <RUN-ID> [--decision DECISION] [--expected-revision EXPECTED-REVISION] [--criteria-file CRITERIA-FILE] [--notes NOTES] [--request-id REQUEST-ID] [--owner OWNER] [--env-profile ENV-PROFILE]  # Record an explicit owner acceptance decision and its evidence notes.
│   ├── show <TASK-ID> [--owner OWNER] [--env-profile ENV-PROFILE]  # Show a Task and its immutable round history.
│   └── submit [INSTRUCTIONS] [--instructions-file INSTRUCTIONS-FILE] [--template TEMPLATE] [--parameters-file PARAMETERS-FILE] [--image-profile IMAGE-PROFILE] [--request-id REQUEST-ID] [--env-profile ENV-PROFILE]  # Submit natural language over authenticated HTTP and return its Web URL.
└── worker [--once] [--operator OPERATOR] [--env-profile ENV-PROFILE]  # Run the independent durable queue executor under a process-held lock.

--tree-brief 保留命令节点与描述，但隐藏参数签名。repository register 是受信服务器端操作：路径必须是干净、精确的 Git 根目录；网页没有登记路径的接口。示例：

chattask repository register --id demo --path /srv/managed/demo --github-repo owner/demo --package-name demo
chattask serve --env-profile site --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000

paths只解析 $CHATARCH_HOME/chattask 等目录，不创建它们。serve 显式构造服务，Web 生命周期负责中断恢复标记与原有会话清理；CLI 只启动任务执行器，不持有 GitHub/PyPI 上游凭据；任务的外部写权限由工具服务控制，镜像由运维预装。

docs.title: Python 接口树
docs.text:
通用任务入口：chattask.agent_tasks.AgentTaskService（create/get/list/wait/cancel）、run_task；执行器：chattask.codex_tasks.CodexTaskExecutor，配置：CodexRuntime。任务只提供说明、镜像配置和可选的前次结果 ID，不提供宿主密钥或路径。

CLI 和 Web 复用可导入的业务层；导入 chattask 本身不连接 Docker、读取令牌、建目录或启动服务。

chattask
├── TaskSettings / settings.load_settings(profile=..., home=...)
├── TaskService                    # 旧整数 Task 与持续 Shell
│   ├── once(values)
│   ├── open_session() / run_session(id, command) / close_session(id)
│   └── sweep() / shutdown()
├── TaskStore(root)                # 私有原子模板/仓库/运行/产物存储
├── WorkflowService(store, source=..., executor=..., tool_client=..., release_adapter=...)
│   ├── templates() / save_template(spec, update=False)
│   ├── register_repository(id, path, github_repo, default_branch, package_name)
│   ├── create_run(owner, body) / get_run(owner, id) / list_runs(owner)
│   ├── cancel(owner, id) / approve(owner, id, exact_body) / artifact(owner, id, name)
│   └── recover() / shutdown()
├── source.GitSource               # 干净 Git 根/跟踪归档/固定 SHA
├── executor.SandboxExecutor       # OpenSandbox 真执行与独立清理核验
├── tool_client.ChatPyPITools      # PyPI 命名 profile / ChatAuth TokenStore / REST
├── release.ChatGHReleaseAdapter   # 已合并 PR、检查、标签写入/核对
├── workspace_analysis.WorkspaceAnalysis  # 材料草稿/确认/Run/摘要报告，独立只读执行器
├── durable.DurableTaskService  # create/list/get/runs/resume/pause/complete/grant/artifact/worker_once
│   └── package/revise_package/export_package/reuse_package/evaluate_package/evaluations/review_package
├── task_packages  # validate_files/read_definition_directory/definition_zip/run_archive
├── task_templates.TaskTemplateService  # catalog/instantiate/library；参数和资源引用，不发放权限
├── package_service.PackageService  # 既有发布流程加 task_definition/export_task/export_task_data
├── task_verification.SandboxPackageVerifier  # 新 Sandbox 独立验证与资源回收核对
├── task_trajectories.codex_to_atif  # 仅转换实际可观察原生事件
├── durable.executor_lock / run_worker  # 单写者进程锁与独立队列执行
├── durable_archive.validate_checkpoint  # 私有归档结构、预算及已知凭据扫描
├── durable_research.source_records / research_files  # 有界来源和本轮研究产物适配
├── create_app(settings, service=..., workflow=..., agent_tasks=..., analysis=..., durable_tasks=...)
└── state_paths(home=...)

WorkflowService.create_run 接受 request_id、repository_id、template_id、version，以及可选 install_extras（最多四个简单名称）和 pull_request。认证所有者由 Web 服务端传入；浏览器不能指定所有者或宿主路径。内置模板 ID 是 python-release。自定义模板允许的步骤为 probe、test（pytest / unittest / compileall）、build、check；check 必须在 build 后。修订后已创建运行仍绑定旧步骤快照。

approve 只接受运行处于 awaiting_approval 时的精确字典：action=tag、同一 repository_id、version、source_sha、source_tree、confirmation=TAG owner/repo vVERSION。后端要求已合并 PR 的源码树等于预检树、精确 test CI/CI工作流通过，并要求合版树仍等于预检树。结果可能是 blocked、release_unknown 或 awaiting_publication，后者不代表包已发布。产物下载会再次核对字节大小和 SHA256。

Web lifespan负责恢复标记和显式关闭。直接使用 Python 长期会话或工作流的调用方也应管理这两个方法。所有生产依赖连接在显式构造/调用后才发生；源码离线测试使用注入的合成客户端与临时存储。

docs.title: Research 发布适配器
docs.text: chattask.research 是可选的可信服务端发布模块。现有持久 Task API 必须先完成 Task/Run 身份认证与授权，再调用发布器。浏览器和访客不能选择容器、命令、账号、主机路径或下载 URL。

docs.title: Python 接口
docs.text:
from chattask.research import DockerOverleafBridge, ResearchPublisher

from chattask.research_compiler import IsolatedResearchCompiler
compiler = IsolatedResearchCompiler(docker_client, "<私有编译状态目录>", "<由运维配置的容器>")
bridge = DockerOverleafBridge(container_name="<由运维配置的容器>", origin="https://<由运维配置的服务地址>", compiler=compiler)
publisher = ResearchPublisher(state_root="<私有状态目录>", bridge=bridge)
result = publisher.publish(task_id, run_id, {
    "main.tex": "<自包含 ctexart 源码，含文内参考文献>",
    "references.bib": "<可选的参考文献镜像>",
}, request_id, expected_root_doc_id=None)
# result.receipt、result.pdf_bytes、result.source_zip_bytes
# bridge.project_url(result.receipt["project_id"])

publish 是同步接口；await publisher.apublish(...) 在工作线程执行。测试可注入同步或异步 bridge(payload) -> native_result，这种结果只属于合成测试，不能当作原站验收。research_instructions(topic, source_records, followup=False) 根据调用方提供的已核实来源生成普通 Codex Task 提示，不自行发现来源。来源记录必须含规范 id、url、title、content（或 excerpt）；支持 retrieved_at/read_scope 或 accessed_at/read_boundary。截断证据时明确标注，提示不超过 Task 的 16000 字符上限。要求输出绝对路径 /workspace/result/research/main.tex、/workspace/result/research/references.bib、/workspace/result/research/report.md 和 /workspace/result/research/sources.json。

每个 Task 只绑定一个私有原生工程，并用确定的工程名和 Task 标记核对。每轮 Run 的平面文档名加 r_<run-id>_ 前缀；重试时，已存在文档必须与原内容完全一致。只有原生根文档指针仍等于前次托管值，才切换新根文档。未完成操作通过原站 DocumentUpdater 当前文档读回核对后继续。成功收据及字节在私有日志中不可变。源码 ZIP 由原站当前文档读回内容重建，并非声称下载了 HTTP 工程 ZIP。

原生辅助脚本以固定 docker exec 参数进入现有服务容器，静态 Node 源码由软件包提供，请求 JSON 只走标准输入。它使用原服务配置的管理员邮箱查找唯一现有 isAdmin 用户。这是可信运维边界内的原生脚本调用，不是浏览器登录。publish_source 只调用原生工程创建、文档更新、根文档条件切换及当前源码回读，绝不调用原站编译器。可信桥接器以运维配置的 origin 和原生工程 id 生成已验证的工程链接。辅助脚本有 13 分钟自到期边界；Python 最多等待 Docker 客户端 14 分钟，不发送 kill/terminate。外层超时会保留待核对日志及主机 Docker 客户端 PID。

写入原站前，worker 从受信 Docker 元数据核对原容器的不可变镜像 ID 和公共 TeX 工具链挂载。原站源码读回核实后，IsolatedResearchCompiler 使用新的 Run 标记容器编译：仅挂载只读当前文稿和公共 TeX 树，以及单次编译专用的 PDF 导出目录，不挂载原站应用数据；网络关闭、非 root、根文件系统只读、移除能力、清空进程环境，并限制 CPU、内存、进程数及 tmpfs 输出。固定 xelatex 参数关闭 shell escape，运行两遍，只取有界的有效 PDF，并按精确容器身份清理。清理结果不明时保持阻塞，交由运维核对；收据记录隔离镜像及编译来源，不返回主机路径或凭据。

docs.title: Hermes 集成步骤
docs.text:
1. 合并时将 overleaf_native.mjs 加入 package-data；否则安装包会缺少辅助脚本。
  2. 桥接器配置留在可信服务端。未配置 Overleaf 时，普通 Task 应照常工作。
  3. 现有 Task API 先授权调用方，再使用稳定 request id、当前托管根文档 id 调用 publish。单独传入 owner id 不构成认证。
  4. 将返回的 PDF、源码 ZIP 和含哈希的收据持久化为 Task 产物。未知/未完成操作保持待核对状态，不能拿提交的文本伪造成功。
  5. 部署后必须验收真实两轮研究、编译、下载和外部根文档变更冲突；源码测试和本机编译检查不代替原站验收。

首版最多接受 20 个平面文本文件（.tex、.bib、.md、.json），单文件不超过 1 MiB，总量不超过 4 MiB。main.tex 必须是自包含的 ctexart 文档；外部 TeX 输入、图片和任意素材映射不在首版支持范围。PDF 收据要求独立隔离容器中的 xelatex 编译成功，并从该容器取回有界的有效 PDF。

Python 预检与可信原生辅助脚本都采用首版窄范围 TeX 白名单，只接受两轮已核实文稿使用的命令：author、begin/end、bibitem、cite、date、documentclass、emph、hline、item、maketitle、section/subsection、仅设置 tabcolsep 的 setlength、small、texttt、title、url、usepackage、转义下划线与换行。只接受 ctexart 类、geometry/url/longtable 包及 document/abstract/enumerate/thebibliography/longtable 环境。未知宏、原始注释、^^、括号或环境不配对、不安全 URL 与任意包选项均拒绝。白名单不能证明 TeX 引擎完全隔离；supervisor 仍需独立核查编译器隔离和原服务私有配置边界。

原生操作结果不明时，同一 Run 在准确的 Docker 客户端进程（PID 加系统启动/进程起始标识）可能仍运行期间禁止重试。只有取得正常带帧退出回执，或经过 13 分钟原生截止时间加有界宽限，并读回原站当前文档与根文档指针核对后，才启动下一个发布辅助进程。/proc 证据不足或读回不确定时，私有日志保持待核对。桥接器不发送进程信号；日志里的 PID 是主机 Docker 客户端 PID，不能证明远端是否已写入。

docs.title: 任务包生命周期（未发布候选）
docs.text:
创建即初始化任务包，不是结束后才拼装 ZIP。task.toml 使用 Harbor 1.4 结构；目的、交付物、验收、模板和资源声明在 metadata.chatarch 扩展下。该适配器校验有限子集，不等于支持 Harbor 的全部环境/Agent 插件，也不会自动安装 Harbor/Rewardkit。

task.toml                         # 结构化入口、目的、交付物和逐项验收
instruction.md                    # 给执行 Agent 的完整说明
inputs/                           # 参数、来源和资源引用；无凭据
environment/skills/<name>/SKILL.md # 可选任务范围方法，不是全局授权
tests/test.sh                     # 独立 verifier 入口，只在新 Sandbox 执行
tests/checks.py                    # 程序检查（按任务需要提供）
tests/quality.toml                 # 可选模型 rubric
tests/judge-guide.md               # 可选评审指南

自然语言任务先保存待准备定义，再由 Agent 补齐检查/rubric；服务端冻结定义版本后才求解。导入的完整定义无需重新准备。运行结束、独立验证和人工接受分别存储；缺失条目、verifier 异常、未评审及清理未知均不算通过，必需条目不因平均分较高而被忽略。执行中不能改写冻结标准；后续修订用 CAS 创建新版本，旧 Run 不变。

每轮私有数据单元保存对应定义、实际事件/可观察 ATIF、交付物、reward/details 和验收决定；原生 checkpoint 只用于续跑，不进入可复用导出。复用创建新 Task，不复制原账号、检查点、评分或授权。失败记录同样保留；任务库不是公开数据集。ATIF 是事件交换格式，不是原生会话恢复格式。

网页支持文本定义文件导入、规范编辑/取消/修订、任务库筛选、复用、定义与本轮证据下载、显式人工验收。程序 API 由 DurableTaskService、TaskTemplateService 与 PackageService 提供；CLI 以真实 chattask --tree 为准：

chattask task package init ./example-task '实现一个有测试的小工具' --image '<operator-image>'
chattask task package validate ./example-task
chattask task create --definition-dir ./example-task --image-profile python-package \
  --request-id example-create --owner operator --env-profile site

validate --official 额外要求运行环境已有固定 Harbor 0.25.0 schema；默认本地校验明确返回 official_schema_checked=false，不执行任务。定义最多 64 个 UTF-8 文件/256 KiB，不跟随符号链接。HTTP 请求体另有独立限制。

接口 作用 GET /api/task-templates 固定模板及显式版本、参数约束 POST /api/task-templates/{id}/instantiate request_id、template_revision、parameters；普通模板另选已登记 image_profile GET /api/task-resources 资源是否配置；不探测可用性、不返回秘密 GET /api/task-library 当前身份可见的普通 Task 与 Python 发版 Task，最多 100 项 GET/PUT /api/durable/tasks/{id}/package 读取定义、按 expected_revision 和稳定 request_id 保存新 files GET /api/durable/tasks/{id}/package.zip 下载定义；可选 revision POST /api/durable/tasks/{id}/reuse 新私有实例，不继承通过状态 POST /api/durable/tasks/{id}/runs/{run}/evaluate 持久排队，独立 worker 执行，不在 HTTP 请求内运行脚本 GET /api/durable/tasks/{id}/runs/{run}/evaluations 原轮次的验证历史 POST /api/durable/tasks/{id}/review request_id、run_id、expected_revision、decision、逐项 criteria、notes 的显式人工决定

独立 verifier 从冻结定义及本轮输出启动一个新 Sandbox；镜像须已包含任务需要的 Python/Rewardkit/受支持 Codex judge。缺依赖或上游不可用属于验证错误，不能伪装成内容不合格或合格。已配置的模型、镜像或网关引用不证明当前可用性。

docs.title: 从对话直接创建
docs.text:
对话 Agent 可调用认证 POST /api/task-intake，或使用同一 HTTP 客户端的薄 CLI：

chattask task submit '写一个带测试的小工具，说明目的和验收要求' \
  --request-id message-unique-id --env-profile site

命名 site profile 通过原配置加载站点地址和账号，凭据不出现在命令参数或任务定义中。服务端按登录身份创建任务；当只有一个已配置镜像时自动选择，否则需明确 --image-profile。返回 JSON 中的 task_id、status 和 url；打开链接后登录即可查看该任务，不必手填网页表单。请求 ID 应来自原消息的稳定身份，响应不明时不得换新键重发。

模板可用 --template research-report|python-package --parameters-file parameters.json；参数是相同模板字段的数据，不包含凭据。Python 发版只创建草稿，不因对话提交自动预检、合版或发布。已有可信服务器端 task create --owner ... 是本机管理入口，不能把它当作跨服务身份认证；对话/自动化优先使用 task submit。

docs.title: Python 发版也是 Task
docs.text:
选择 python-package@1 后保存参数即生成任务包，不调度发布。资源包括模型、受控环境、精确仓库、OIDC Publisher 与包索引；只保存引用，服务端按阶段发放已有受限能力。既有项目默认复用原发布链，不重复登录 PyPI 或重建 Publisher。

发版继续由原 PackageService 执行：只读预检 → 精确目标/计划确认 → 受限发布 → 独立回读。阶段记录绑定原生任务 ID、草稿修订和定义版本；参数变更使旧预检/确认失效，不覆盖旧规范。task-package / task-package.zip（在 /api/package/drafts/{id}/ 下）提供定义读取/下载，task-data.zip 导出版本化定义、真实阶段状态、可信校验/发布回执及其他产物的摘要引用；任意工作区和原生会话不会被自动复制。程序发布核验不等于人工业务验收。

这不增加另一个发布引擎，也不把选择模板或提交资源当成 push、PR、合版、标签、上传或生产重启许可。候选功能与已发布版本须分别验收。

docs.title: 长期任务候选
docs.text:
长期 Task 与一次性 chattask run 独立：POST /api/durable/tasks 接受 request_id、instructions、image_profile，登录主体成为所有者；GET /api/durable/tasks、/{id}、/{id}/runs 返回私有历史。POST /{id}/resume 接受新的 request_id、instructions 和可选 acknowledge_unknown=true；POST /{id}/pause、/{id}/complete 接受 request_id。POST /{id}/members 仅所有者可授予已命名主体 viewer 或 editor，所有控制请求记载发起者。GET /{id}/runs/{run_id}/artifacts/{name} 在权限和 SHA256 核对后下载产物。路径均以 /api/durable/tasks 为前缀；所有写入使用已有站点 CSRF。请求 ID 重复且输入相同返回原结果，输入不同返回冲突；活动轮次不能重复接续。

创建时 workflow=development 为默认；研究任务可显式设置 workflow=research 并提供 1–12 条已核对来源 source_records，也可在登录后调用 POST /api/durable/research/auto，提供 request_id、研究 instructions、image_profile、英文或中文纯文本 query 和可选 max_results（1–5），由可信服务端检索 arXiv 官方 Atom 摘要并把实际来源快照保存到 Task。自动检索仅含摘要，不代表读过论文全文；须人工核查相关性。后续轮次可提供新来源记录，否则继承上一轮。模型需写 /workspace/result/research/main.tex，采用自包含 ctexart/xelatex 和内联参考文献；references.bib、报告和来源元数据可另存。受信 worker 只从本轮结果归档读取研究文件，不接受浏览器给出的容器、工程、用户、路径或命令。原 Overleaf 工程由受信 ResearchPublisher 绑定同一 Task，PDF 与源码回读作为本轮 research.pdf、research-source.zip 产物；完成前记录原生工程收据并展示工程链接。编译、同步或冲突失败保持阻塞。外部结果不明时，检查原工程后使用 POST /{id}/reconcile-research，附新的 request_id 和 acknowledge_unknown=true；独立 worker 用同一 Run/发布操作身份核对，不重跑 Codex。

研究桥仅在同时配置 CHATTASK_RESEARCH_OVERLEAF_CONTAINER 与 HTTPS CHATTASK_RESEARCH_OVERLEAF_ORIGIN 时启用，普通开发任务不依赖它们。可选敏感 CHATTASK_LOGIN_USERS_JSON 为最多八条 username、password、principal_id、display_name 记录，经共享 ChatLogin 验证；原站点管理员用户名/密码及 site-operator 主体保留，主体 ID 必须唯一。不要在生产配置中创建测试账号。所有配置由运维提供，不由浏览器传入。

Web 只排队；独立运行 chattask worker --env-profile site --operator operator，可用 --once 有界处理一轮。可信本机 CLI 使用 chattask task create/list/show/resume/pause/complete 与显式 --owner、--env-profile。Worker 必须配置原模型网关、OpenSandbox 和已登记镜像；一个进程持有原生 flock，重启发现运行中轮次会标为中断并要求人工核对可能的外部写入。队列不会自动重放。Web 重启不取消独立 worker。

每轮在新 Sandbox 运行，保存 /workspace/work、/workspace/result 和 $CODEX_HOME/sessions 的有限归档；拒绝链接、越界路径、特殊文件、敏感文件名、超额内容和已知临时凭据。成功轮次需要原生 session ID、turn.completed、已验证检查点、容器回收与网关租约关闭。恢复时使用精确 session ID 的 codex exec resume，在 guest 验证命令选项；不复制上一轮文字作为新会话。暂停是协作式阶段边界操作：排队轮次可在运行前暂停，运行中轮次到本轮结束才暂停。失败或中断需检查后显式接续；首轮没有检查点的失败保持阻塞。生产可用性仍需以部署后的真实镜像、网关、原站与浏览器验收为准。

  • 任务：用户目标、验收要求、稳定请求 ID、镜像配置；可选择自己此前的结果作为输入。
  • 执行器：Codex 在一个真实 Sandbox 的工作目录中执行任务，不在宿主运行任务源码。
  • 镜像：提供 Codex、配套程序、Python、Shell 以及任务所需工具；工具和依赖由运维预先准备。
  • 结果：最终说明、原生事件记录、输出文件摘要与独立回收记录。发包只是任务例子，不是执行器的固定流程。

docs.title: 配置边界
docs.text:
通过 ChatEnv 的 ChatTask 配置提供 CHATTASK_CODEX_BASE_URL、敏感字段 CHATTASK_CODEX_API_KEY、CHATTASK_CODEX_MODEL、CHATTASK_CODEX_IMAGES 和可选的成对配置 CHATTASK_CODEX_TOOLS_URL / 敏感 CHATTASK_CODEX_TOOLS_TOKEN。模型与工具凭据分开，不能把模型 Key 当工具 Token。镜像配置是 JSON 对象，例如 {"python-package":"<operator-provisioned-image>"}；浏览器只能选择已登记的配置 ID。

镜像中不得写入密钥。运行时通过命令环境注入 Codex 使用的访问凭据；环境变量仍可被 guest 程序读取，因此应使用短期、受限的模型/工具网关凭据。GitHub PAT、PyPI 密码、会话、TOTP 和上传密钥保留在对应工具服务端。任务输入不能选择宿主路径、原始 token、任意 provider 地址或任意镜像。

当前镜像约定包含 codex 及该版本需要的配套工具宿主程序、Python 3、sh。根据任务需要加入 Git、编译器、ChatPyPI 或其他 infra；发包镜像不代表通用任务必须使用 Python 包工具。普通 Docker/runc 是受信用户的隔离环境，不是对敌对多租户的强隔离保证。

docs.title: 命令入口
docs.text:
chattask run --instructions-file task.txt \
  --image-profile python-package --request-id task-001 \
  --env-profile site --json-output

同一请求 ID 和相同输入只返回已有任务；不同输入复用 ID 会被拒绝。--input-task-id 只接受同一用户已有、摘要校验通过的结果归档。CLI 调用复用 chattask.agent_tasks.run_task；网页和 HTTP 使用同一 AgentTaskService / CodexTaskExecutor。

docs.title: 接口入口
docs.text:
接口 作用 GET /api/agent/images 可用镜像配置 POST /api/agent/tasks 提交 request_id、instructions、image_profile 和可选 input_task_id GET /api/agent/tasks 当前用户的任务 GET /api/agent/tasks/{id} 状态、结果、步骤、镜像与清理证据 POST /api/agent/tasks/{id}/cancel 记录合作式取消请求 GET /api/runs/{id}/artifacts/{name} 带摘要校验的结果文件下载

接口复用站点登录和 CSRF 边界，不暴露模型或工具凭据。关闭浏览器不会取消服务器已接收的任务。

docs.title: 状态与验收
docs.text:
queued → running → completed / blocked / interrupted。completed 只表示原生 Codex 回合完成、结果已收集且 Sandbox 已回收；不能仅凭模型自述就认定外部发布成功。发包任务还必须有真实仓库、Publisher、合版标签、OIDC 上传、注册表及安装回读证据。

默认 Codex 命令预算 900 秒，Sandbox 寿命另加清理余量；控制面必须允许所选寿命。默认仍保持单 Sandbox 的 1 CPU、512 MiB、128 PIDs、无宿主挂载和回环数据端口。失败回合尽可能保留脱敏的原生事件；未知外部写入绝不自动重放。

docs.title: Python 发包模板（候选源码）
docs.text:
Python 发包是同一任务入口中的版本化模板；网页表单与 GET /api/package/schema 共用字段定义。输入一句话只会预填明确的项目模式和规范包名，不会从名称猜测功能。用户需填写模块、CLI、所有者与仓库、描述及明确的功能要求；默认目标版本 0.0.2、Python >=3.10、MIT、双语 MkDocs、私有仓库与标准 CI/OIDC。字面名称在任何远端查询前验证，不自动改名。现有项目必须选 existing，不会创建占位包或重建仓库。

草稿保存在 ChatTask 私有状态目录，并绑定站点身份。创建、修改、预检、确认分别要求稳定 request_id；编辑增加修订号并使旧预览失效。预检是读权限受限的真实 Codex Sandbox 任务。它读取目标事实，生成完整源码和新项目的 0.0.1 占位 wheel/sdist；受信校验器在 Sandbox 中运行测试与构建，服务端再以限额读取归档，核对源码、分发包、摘要和目标。网页展示目标与权限，用户勾选授权后点击确认；协议中的确认值、修订、预检任务/归档摘要、源码清单与动作权限共同绑定，无需手抄哈希。确认后才创建第二个带受限发布能力的任务。外部仓库、CI、OIDC、注册表和安装回执由受信后处理核对，不能把模型总结当成发布成功。

接口 作用 GET /api/package/schema / POST /api/package/intent 通道中立表单字段与保守意图预填 GET/POST /api/package/drafts 当前用户草稿列表与创建 GET/PUT /api/package/drafts/{id} 草稿详情与修订 POST /api/package/drafts/{id}/prepare 提交只读预检 POST /api/package/drafts/{id}/confirm 提交精确预览和确认文字 GET /api/agent/tasks/{id}/artifacts/{name} 已授权任务的摘要校验下载

以上接口沿用现有登录和 CSRF。网页 URL 中只保留草稿 ID，参数和短期凭据不进入 URL。飞书侧只可复用现有按钮卡片的动作；需要填文字时打开同一站点的认证表单。本包没有飞书传输或原生输入回调。

docs.title: 受信网关
docs.text:
可选的 CHATTASK_GATEWAY_URL 必须是 HTTPS origin，并与敏感 CHATTASK_GATEWAY_CLIENT_TOKEN 成对配置。发包预检与提交要求此网关；通用任务仍可沿用既有配置。每次真实任务执行开始时，控制端用任务 ID 向 POST /control/sessions 请求会话：generic 的 plan 为 null 且只有模型访问；prepare 的策略为 project,repository,version,description,mode,release_branch,tag；publish 再增加精确 sources 清单摘要与 base_sha、artifact_digests 和 actions。未知创建结果只按相同任务 ID 核对，不换新键。网关返回的模型和工具 token 分开注入 guest；原始上游密钥不进入 ChatTask 配置或 Sandbox。CHATTASK_CODEX_HOSTS 仅接受运维提供的 hostname→IP JSON，映射只追加到 guest 的 /etc/hosts。

网关会话响应必须将 id 精确绑定任务 ID，model_base_url 必须为 /sessions//v1；发包任务的 tool_base_url 必须为同一会话根路径，通用任务不接收工具 URL。可选 CHATTASK_GATEWAY_CA_FILE 指向运维提供的绝对路径、公有 PEM CA（最多 64 KiB）；控制端以默认系统信任为基础加载它，Sandbox 在系统 CA 包后追加这份证书，并将合并包提供给 Codex、Python 和 Requests。控制 token 与 CA 私钥不进入 Sandbox。

发包预检每分支最多 100 个文件、单文件 200000 字节、合计 2000000 字节。确认后，原生 Codex 完成仅代表候选执行完成；受信后处理还要重新校验批准的计划哈希，从受限 /github/api/status 回读精确 release 源码清单、PR/合并 SHA、两次精确 HEAD CI、合并树 tag 和实际 publish.yml 的 Publish-to-PyPI job/step。然后核验目标版本 PyPI JSON 与 wheel/sdist 文件 SHA256，并在全新 Sandbox venv 安装，运行声明的 CLI --version 和 --tree。任何缺失或失败都将任务标为 blocked，成功证据保存在 trusted-publication.json 和安装日志。受限 status 接口需返回 repository、branches（release SHA、manifest_digest 与 base_sha、main SHA 和 manifest_digest）、pull_request、ci.release / ci.main、tag、publish（workflow/head SHA、job/step 名称、结论和实际 publish action）字段；字段必须来自提供方回执。

发布核验经同一受限工具会话 GET /pypi/api/release 读取精确版本 JSON；新项目另经 GET /pypi/api/placeholder 核验 0.0.1。仅按官方文件摘要请求 GET /pypi/api/artifacts/{sha256}（单文件最多 10 MiB），再次计算字节摘要并安装已核验的目标 wheel。网关须将这些固定只读路由限制到已批准项目、版本与官方文件摘要。配置现有 CHATTASK_PUBLIC_DEPS_PATH 和 CHATTASK_PUBLIC_DEPS_SHA256 时，受信后处理只从已校验归档的 deps/wheelhouse/*.whl 提取依赖到全新目录，使用 --no-index --find-links 安装目标 wheel；归档内已安装的 .py/.so 文件不当作 wheel。归档缺少 wheel、摘要或路径不合格会阻断核验。未配置归档时保留显式公共索引依赖解析。回执记录依赖来源和归档 SHA256；运维需提供包含原基础文件与 wheelhouse 的新固定归档。

网关服务、目标工具策略、镜像中的 build/test 依赖、真实发布回读与部署由受信控制面负责；这些源码接口本身不表示服务已经上线。CLI 可用 chattask package schema|plan|draft-create|draft-show|prepare|confirm。CLI 草稿使用独立的受信 operator 身份，与网页草稿隔离。

docs.title: 已提交发包的只读重新核验
docs.text: 若原发布任务已经结束但最终只读回读因网络等原因受阻，草稿页显示“只读重新核验”。此按钮使用同一已批准预检归档、源码清单、目标和版本，创建新的受信 Sandbox 核验任务；不会运行 Codex、重新上传、创建 PR 或标签。原发布任务状态与错误保持原样。核验成功后页面分别显示新任务通过和原任务记录；失败时可用新请求 ID 显式再核验。网络结果不确定时，浏览器保留原请求 ID 并用同一键核对。网关 verify 会话只提供受限只读工具，不提供模型访问；控制端发送原策略加 verification_of 原发布任务 ID。公共注册表和受限状态查询只对超时/连接失败作最多两次有界尝试，证书、权限、目标和摘要失败直接阻断。

docs.title: Workspace 材料分析
docs.text: 场景 接口 边界 查看结果 已登录 Task 页面「材料分析」 只读，不启动 Run 整理任务 受信服务创建不可变草稿 固定资料、来源版本和摘要 执行分析 单独确认草稿版本和摘要 真实模型请求，不调用工具或读取宿主文件

docs.title: 配置
docs.text:
在现有 ChatTask 命名 profile 中设置 CHATTASK_WORKSPACE_KEY（32–512 UTF-8 字节的服务端共享凭据）和 CHATTASK_ANALYSIS_PROFILE（已有 ChatEnv OpenAI 命名 profile）。模型 base、key、model 由已有 profile 在服务器端读取，不复制到浏览器或源码；空配置禁用集成认证或模型启动。服务凭据只能存入批准的私有配置，不能写进 URL、前端、日志或仓库。

该执行器与 Codex + Sandbox 通用任务分开：只分析显式提供的 context，不使用宿主工具、不执行代码、不访问其他文件。它不是 Codex 故障时的自动模型替代路径。默认完整请求截止 180 秒，另有限制连接、单次读取和字节大小；失败保留为终态，不切换付费渠道或自动重放。

docs.title: 服务合约
docs.text:
以下服务间路径需要独立 Bearer 认证，Host 必须匹配部署 origin；存在 Origin 时也必须一致。该凭据不能登录网页或读取普通私有 API。单个正文上限 65536 字节。

方法 路径 返回 GET /integrations/workspace/capabilities provided_materials_only 范围及模型配置状态 POST /integrations/workspace/tasks 新草稿 201；同一请求重读 200 GET /integrations/workspace/tasks?actor=...&proposal_id=... 该主体与建议的任务 GET /integrations/workspace/tasks/{task_id}?actor=... 不可变任务及 Run 历史 POST /integrations/workspace/tasks/{task_id}/runs 显式确认后创建 Run POST /integrations/workspace/tasks/{task_id}/runs/{run_id}/cancel 取消该主体的执行 GET /integrations/workspace/tasks/{task_id}/runs/{run_id}/report?actor=... 文本、大小和 SHA256

草稿必须完整提交 actor、稳定 request_id、title、instructions、acceptance、source、context。source 包含 site_id=workspace-web、proposal_id、两个 64 位小写十六进制版本摘要 catalog_revision / proposal_revision 和非空 project_ids。每份 context 包含 id、title、kind（summary / document / code）、text；资料合计至多 24000 字符。主体由受信调用方的已认证身份派生，不信任浏览器自己声明的 actor。

启动 Run 必须提交同一 actor、独立稳定 request_id、task_version、source_digest、confirmed=true。重复请求不会产生第二次执行，改变内容后复用同一请求 ID 返回冲突。状态依次为 queued、running，最后为 succeeded / failed / cancelled / interrupted。重启只将未结束 Run 标为 interrupted，不重放。最多五个活跃 Run，串行模型执行。

docs.title: 结果与证据
docs.text:
同一材料分析状态目录只允许一个活动控制器。启动恢复或首次执行前取得进程共享的独占锁；第二个控制器拒绝执行、取消和恢复，不会把仍在运行的任务改为 interrupted。shutdown() 等待本控制器任务结束后释放锁，进程退出也会释放锁；Python 调用方应在 finally 中调用 shutdown()。读取已保存报告不需要执行所有权。

report.md 绑定 Task、原建议、资料版本、来源摘要与实际模型。读取时重新核对文件大小与 SHA256；只有语义完整的模型结束才算成功。报告只证明给定材料的分析完成，不代表原建议、部署或发布已经完成。

原站点账号可访问 /?workspace_task=<32位Task ID>，登录后回到同一任务，查看 Run 与报告。普通 /api/workspace-tasks 及其详情/报告仍由 ChatLogin 保护，服务 key 不能代替登录。浏览器只读显示已有任务；网络失败保留上次报告并提示过期，登录失效清除受保护视图。单用户管理员视图不作为多租户权限系统。

Python 调用复用 chattask.workspace_analysis.WorkspaceAnalysis 的 create_task、create_run、get_task、report、cancel、recover 和 shutdown；CLI 树保持不变，不新增只输出计划的命令。

docs.title: ChatTask integration
docs.text: These template capabilities start in ChatTask 0.1.0; historical PyPI 0.0.2 is only a CLI scaffold. Check the actual PyPI version before installing. The older integer-statistics task and persistent Shell experiment remain in the primary navigation.

docs.title: Architecture and prerequisites
docs.text:
Authenticated Web → ChatTask templates/private runs → ChatPyPI metadata tool
                                           └→ OpenSandbox → tracked-source test/build/check
Exact approval → ChatGH/GitHub merged PR and checks → tag → existing OIDC publish workflow

Provide an existing OpenSandbox control plane and Docker access, a fixed site account, a published ChatPyPI service, a native ChatAuth access token and an existing PyPI ChatEnv named profile. The operator owns installation, deployment, token issue and renewal. ChatTask does not provision them. Each Sandbox remains bounded by the 600-second backend TTL, 1 CPU, 512 MiB, 128 PIDs, loopback ports and no host mounts. Project build/test code runs only inside it.

docs.title: Candidate setup
docs.text:
python -m pip install -e '.[web]'
chattask --tree
chattask paths --json-output

Create a ChatTask ChatEnv named profile such as site with actual values corresponding to these placeholders:

CHATTASK_SANDBOX_ENDPOINT=http://127.0.0.1:8080
CHATTASK_SANDBOX_API_KEY=<existing-control-plane-key>
CHATTASK_IMAGE=python:3.10-slim
CHATTASK_WEB_ORIGIN=https://task.example.test
CHATTASK_LOGIN_USERNAME=<site-account>
CHATTASK_LOGIN_PASSWORD=<site-password>
CHATTASK_TOOL_PROFILE=task-tools

CHATTASK_TOOL_PROFILE is only a pointer to an existing PyPI named profile. ChatPyPI's load_pypi_env_profile reads that PyPI ChatEnv profile, which should contain CHATPYPI_MODE=service, CHATPYPI_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:10255 and CHATPYPI_AUTH_PROFILE=task-pypi. ChatTask does not duplicate service URL or token fields. At invocation it reads the native TokenStore().read('ChatAuth', profile) access token. The initial service permits metadata probes only, not ChatPyPI package upload. Example values are placeholders and do not belong in source or logs.

An operator registers an exact clean trusted Git root. The browser has no path/URL registration route:

chattask repository register --id demo --path /srv/managed/demo --github-repo owner/demo --default-branch main --package-name demo
chattask serve --env-profile site --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000

At run time the repository is checked again and HEAD/tree are pinned. Only tracked source is archived; the archive is rebuilt directly from pinned Git blobs so export-ignore/export-subst cannot change the tested source. Symlinks, submodules, private configuration and oversized archives are rejected. Dependencies install inside the Sandbox from public PyPI by default with finite retries and command/total deadlines, without host proxy or provider credentials. When public connectivity is unreliable, a trusted operator may stage a public deps/ tar.gz matched to the workload Python minor/architecture and set both CHATTASK_PUBLIC_DEPS_PATH (absolute) and CHATTASK_PUBLIC_DEPS_SHA256 in ChatTask's typed profile. The service validates digest, size and tar members, then stages only those public dependencies inside the Sandbox. Offline project installation uses --no-index; missing dependencies fail honestly. ChatLogin owns login, cookies, Origin and CSRF.

docs.title: Browser flow
docs.text:
Select a template, repository and target version; optionally provide test extras (such as web,dev) and a merged PR number, then create a preflight. Preflight is the default. The built-in template executes pkg_probe, tests, wheel/sdist build and Twine check. Probe exit 1 can mean an occupied name; its actual receipt is shown. Real exit codes/logs, artifact sizes/SHA256, Sandbox ID and cleanup evidence are persisted. Refresh reconnects from history; disconnect does not cancel. Cancellation is cooperative at step boundaries and only becomes “cancelled” after verified cleanup.

Custom templates can select declarative steps, test suite and description, then save a new revision. They cannot submit arbitrary host commands. Only a run with passed tests, build, check and two real artifacts can reach release approval. Approval requires manually typing the exact TAG owner/demo v1.2.3 confirmation and binds repository, version, source commit, source tree and PR. The backend verifies the merged PR source tree, exact test CI/CI workflow, equality of merged/preflight trees, default branch and tag target. Ambiguous writes reconcile by stable tag target; a verified tag remains awaiting_publication until OIDC workflow/PyPI artifact verification, never merely “published”.

docs.title: HTTP contract
docs.text:
Private /api/* routes require login; writes additionally require same-origin Origin and X-CSRF-Token. GET /health only identifies the HTTP package and liveness.

Method Path Purpose GET / POST /api/templates List or create declarative templates PUT /api/templates/{id} Save a new revision without changing bound runs GET /api/templates/{id}/revisions[/{revision}] Read immutable past revisions GET /api/repositories List registered IDs and public metadata, without host paths POST / GET /api/runs Idempotent preflight create with stable request_id / own history GET /api/runs/{id} Own run, steps, cleanup and release state POST /api/runs/{id}/cancel Request cooperative cancellation POST /api/runs/{id}/approve Approve exact tag creation target GET /api/runs/{id}/artifacts/{name} Digest-checked binary download GET /api/tool-connections/status Redacted connection availability

Older /api/tasks and /api/sessions remain. Runs use same-UID private directories and atomic JSON/artifact files under $CHATARCH_HOME/chattask; this is not a multi-tenant database. Restart marks unfinished or in-flight writes interrupted and requires manual reconciliation of the real Sandbox or remote target; it never replays uncertain writes. Login sessions and persistent Shell do not survive restart.

docs.title: Capability map
docs.text:
Capability Implementation Boundary Templates and repositories Built-in Python release template, declarative custom revisions, trusted Git roots registered by CLI Browser cannot submit paths, URLs or host commands; dirty source and tracked private configuration are rejected Durable runs Private atomic JSON, idempotent request IDs, owner binding, step receipts and restart marking Same-UID trust; no replay of interrupted work; not a distributed queue Long-term Task candidate Stable identity, per-round history, single-writer worker, bounded checkpoint and native session resume End-of-round pause and manual failure inspection; production deployment requires separate acceptance Structured Task candidate Creation-time definitions, CAS revisions/frozen rounds, private import/reuse/export and observable ATIF Native checkpoints are not reusable exports; no invented legacy data or automatic public dataset Independent verification candidate Durable evaluation queue, fresh Sandbox, criterion checks/rubrics and separate human decisions Missing dependencies/criteria, errors and unknown cleanup never pass; model judging is not objective truth Task Template candidate Fixed method/acceptance with instance data; Python releases reuse the original workflow and stage history References are not credentials, live availability or publishing grants; real model/deployment acceptance is separate Research round candidate Optional arXiv abstract discovery or caller-verified records, native Codex self-contained TeX, trusted original Overleaf publication and PDF/source readback Abstracts are not full papers; relevance requires review; unknown writes require same-operation reconciliation Sandbox preflight Tracked archive, real tests/build/Twine check, wheel/sdist readback and SHA256, verified destruction Project code runs only in Sandbox; backend TTL 600 seconds with bounded commands and total time ChatPyPI tools Existing PyPI named configuration and ChatAuth TokenStore; bounded non-redirecting async REST Initial approved tool is pkg_probe; exit 1 can mean an occupied name, not an HTTP failure Release approval Exact target confirmation, preflight commit/tree, merged PR exact test CI/CI workflow, equality of merged/preflight trees, default branch and tag-target verification A tag awaits OIDC/PyPI verification and is never labelled published; uncertain writes require reconciliation Web ChatLogin/Origin/CSRF, progress/history/cancel/digest downloads, Sandbox experiment tab Auth loss clears private state; transient errors show a stale-view warning Material analysis Trusted drafts, explicit confirmation, real model Runs and read-only reports Supplied material only; no tools or host-file access; reports do not complete proposals Existing experiments Fixed integer statistics and persistent Shell with explicit cleanup Shell and login sessions do not survive restart

Ordinary Docker/runc is not strong hostile-code isolation. Deployed provider and browser acceptance is separate from source tests.

docs.title: Generic Tasks
docs.text:
chattask run --instructions-file task.txt --image-profile python-package --request-id task-001 -e site --json-output

These are the registered commands observed with chattask --tree.

chattask
├── --help  # Show this message and exit.
├── --version  # Show the version and exit.
├── --tree  # Print the registered CLI tree and exit.
├── --tree-brief  # Print the registered CLI tree without parameter signatures and exit.
├── package  # Inspect and run the versioned Python package template.
│   ├── confirm [--id DRAFT-ID] [--revision REVISION] [--preview-sha256 PREVIEW-SHA256] [--confirmation CONFIRMATION] [--request-id REQUEST-ID] [--env-profile ENV-PROFILE]  # Submit the exact verified preview and wait for its publish task.
│   ├── draft-create [--spec-file SPEC-FILE] [--request-id REQUEST-ID]  # Create an owner-bound draft in the private ChatTask store.
│   ├── draft-show [--id DRAFT-ID]  # Read a draft and its verified preparation preview.
│   ├── plan [--spec-file SPEC-FILE]  # Validate a JSON spec and show exact prepare policy/instructions without executing.
│   ├── prepare [--id DRAFT-ID] [--revision REVISION] [--image-profile IMAGE-PROFILE] [--request-id REQUEST-ID] [--env-profile ENV-PROFILE]  # Run and verify the read-only Sandbox preflight for a saved draft.
│   └── schema  # Print the channel-neutral package form schema.
├── paths [--json-output]  # Resolve ChatArch-contained state paths without creating them.
├── repository  # Manage trusted local source roots for template runs.
│   └── register [--id REPO-ID] [--path PATH] [--github-repo GITHUB-REPO] [--default-branch DEFAULT-BRANCH] [--package-name PACKAGE-NAME]  # Register an operator-trusted Git root; browser users cannot supply paths.
├── run [INSTRUCTIONS] [--instructions-file INSTRUCTIONS-FILE] [--image-profile IMAGE-PROFILE] [--request-id REQUEST-ID] [--input-task-id INPUT-TASK-ID] [--env-profile ENV-PROFILE] [--json-output]  # Run a task using Codex inside an ephemeral Sandbox and return its result.
├── serve [--host HOST] [--port PORT] [--env-profile ENV-PROFILE]  # Serve the authenticated Task/Sandbox browser and API from this package.
├── task  # Control private long-term Tasks; rounds execute in a separate worker.
│   ├── complete <TASK-ID> [--request-id REQUEST-ID] [--owner OWNER] [--env-profile ENV-PROFILE]  # Mark an inactive long-term Task complete; history remains available.
│   ├── create [INSTRUCTIONS] [--definition-dir DEFINITION-DIR] [--image-profile IMAGE-PROFILE] [--workflow WORKFLOW] [--sources-file SOURCES-FILE] [--request-id REQUEST-ID] [--owner OWNER] [--env-profile ENV-PROFILE]  # Queue the first round of a long-term Task.
│   ├── evaluate <TASK-ID> <RUN-ID> [--request-id REQUEST-ID] [--owner OWNER] [--env-profile ENV-PROFILE]  # Request independent verification; unavailable is never a passing score.
│   ├── evaluations <TASK-ID> <RUN-ID> [--owner OWNER] [--env-profile ENV-PROFILE]  # Read persisted evaluation history for one exact round.
│   ├── list [--owner OWNER] [--env-profile ENV-PROFILE]  # List Tasks visible to a trusted local principal.
│   ├── package  # Initialize, validate, version, export and reuse portable task definitions.
│   │   ├── export <TASK-ID> [--revision REVISION] [--output OUTPUT] [--owner OWNER] [--env-profile ENV-PROFILE]  # Export a real definition ZIP, excluding session state and credentials.
│   │   ├── init <DIRECTORY> <INSTRUCTIONS> [--image IMAGE]  # Create a new task.toml, instruction.md and verifier draft without model calls.
│   │   ├── reuse <TASK-ID> [--request-id REQUEST-ID] [--owner OWNER] [--env-profile ENV-PROFILE]  # Create and queue a new private Task without inheriting review or grants.
│   │   ├── revise <TASK-ID> [--definition-dir DEFINITION-DIR] [--expected-revision EXPECTED-REVISION] [--request-id REQUEST-ID] [--owner OWNER] [--env-profile ENV-PROFILE]  # Publish a CAS-checked definition revision without rewriting old rounds.
│   │   ├── show <TASK-ID> [--revision REVISION] [--owner OWNER] [--env-profile ENV-PROFILE]  # Read the selected immutable definition visible to this principal.
│   │   └── validate <DIRECTORY> [--official]  # Validate the supported file contract; does not execute a task or verifier.
│   ├── pause <TASK-ID> [--request-id REQUEST-ID] [--owner OWNER] [--env-profile ENV-PROFILE]  # Pause queued work now or request a cooperative end-of-round pause.
│   ├── reconcile-research <TASK-ID> [--request-id REQUEST-ID] [--acknowledge-unknown] [--owner OWNER] [--env-profile ENV-PROFILE]  # Queue explicit same-round Research readback/reconciliation.
│   ├── resume <TASK-ID> <INSTRUCTIONS> [--request-id REQUEST-ID] [--acknowledge-unknown] [--sources-file SOURCES-FILE] [--owner OWNER] [--env-profile ENV-PROFILE]  # Queue an explicit new native Codex round from a verified checkpoint.
│   ├── review <TASK-ID> <RUN-ID> [--decision DECISION] [--expected-revision EXPECTED-REVISION] [--criteria-file CRITERIA-FILE] [--notes NOTES] [--request-id REQUEST-ID] [--owner OWNER] [--env-profile ENV-PROFILE]  # Record an explicit owner acceptance decision and its evidence notes.
│   ├── show <TASK-ID> [--owner OWNER] [--env-profile ENV-PROFILE]  # Show a Task and its immutable round history.
│   └── submit [INSTRUCTIONS] [--instructions-file INSTRUCTIONS-FILE] [--template TEMPLATE] [--parameters-file PARAMETERS-FILE] [--image-profile IMAGE-PROFILE] [--request-id REQUEST-ID] [--env-profile ENV-PROFILE]  # Submit natural language over authenticated HTTP and return its Web URL.
└── worker [--once] [--operator OPERATOR] [--env-profile ENV-PROFILE]  # Run the independent durable queue executor under a process-held lock.

--tree-brief preserves command nodes and descriptions without signatures. repository register is trusted server-side administration: the path must be an exact clean Git root; the browser has no path-registration endpoint. Example:

chattask repository register --id demo --path /srv/managed/demo --github-repo owner/demo --package-name demo
chattask serve --env-profile site --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000

paths only resolves $CHATARCH_HOME/chattask and related paths. serve explicitly constructs the service; the Web lifespan marks interrupted work and cleans up older sessions. The CLI starts the task executor without holding GitHub/PyPI upstream credentials. Tool services control external-write authority; operators provision images.

docs.title: Python API
docs.text:
Generic tasks use chattask.agent_tasks.AgentTaskService (create/get/list/wait/cancel) and run_task. chattask.codex_tasks.CodexTaskExecutor consumes CodexRuntime; tasks supply instructions, a registered image profile and optional prior result ID, never host secrets or paths.

CLI and Web share importable business APIs. import chattask itself does not connect Docker, read tokens, create state or start services.

chattask
├── TaskSettings / settings.load_settings(profile=..., home=...)
├── TaskService                    # Existing integer task and persistent Shell
│   ├── once(values)
│   ├── open_session() / run_session(id, command) / close_session(id)
│   └── sweep() / shutdown()
├── TaskStore(root)                # Private atomic template/repository/run/artifact store
├── WorkflowService(store, source=..., executor=..., tool_client=..., release_adapter=...)
│   ├── templates() / save_template(spec, update=False)
│   ├── register_repository(id, path, github_repo, default_branch, package_name)
│   ├── create_run(owner, body) / get_run(owner, id) / list_runs(owner)
│   ├── cancel(owner, id) / approve(owner, id, exact_body) / artifact(owner, id, name)
│   └── recover() / shutdown()
├── source.GitSource               # Clean Git root/tracked archive/pinned SHA
├── executor.SandboxExecutor       # Real OpenSandbox execution and independent cleanup check
├── tool_client.ChatPyPITools      # PyPI named profile / ChatAuth TokenStore / REST
├── release.ChatGHReleaseAdapter   # Merged PR, checks, tag write/reconciliation
├── workspace_analysis.WorkspaceAnalysis  # Independent material drafts/Runs/digest-checked reports
├── durable.DurableTaskService  # create/list/get/runs/resume/pause/complete/grant/artifact/worker_once
│   └── package/revise_package/export_package/reuse_package/evaluate_package/evaluations/review_package
├── task_packages  # validate_files/read_definition_directory/definition_zip/run_archive
├── task_templates.TaskTemplateService  # catalog/instantiate/library; references are not grants
├── package_service.PackageService  # Existing release workflow plus task_definition/export_task/export_task_data
├── task_verification.SandboxPackageVerifier  # Independent Sandbox verification and cleanup reconciliation
├── task_trajectories.codex_to_atif  # Converts only actually observed native events
├── durable.executor_lock / run_worker  # Process-held single writer and separate queue executor
├── durable_archive.validate_checkpoint  # Private archive structure, limits and live-token scan
├── durable_research.source_records / research_files  # Bounded supplied sources and round output adapter
├── create_app(settings, service=..., workflow=..., agent_tasks=..., analysis=..., durable_tasks=...)
└── state_paths(home=...)

WorkflowService.create_run accepts request_id, repository_id, template_id, version and optional install_extras (up to four simple names) and pull_request. Web derives the authenticated owner on the server; the browser cannot supply owner or host path. The built-in template ID is python-release. Custom steps are limited to probe, test (pytest / unittest / compileall), build and check; check must follow build. Existing runs keep their bound step snapshot after a new template revision.

approve accepts an exact dictionary only when a run is awaiting_approval: action=tag, matching repository_id, version, source_sha, source_tree and confirmation=TAG owner/repo vVERSION. The backend requires the merged PR source tree to equal the preflight tree, exact test CI/CI workflow success, and the merged tree to remain equal to the preflight tree. Outcomes include blocked, release_unknown and awaiting_publication; the latter is not publication. Artifact downloads recheck byte size and SHA256.

The Web lifespan marks recovery and explicitly shuts down. Direct long-lived Python callers should manage both methods. Production dependency connections happen after explicit construction/invocation; offline source tests inject synthetic clients and temporary stores.

docs.title: Research publisher adapter
docs.text: chattask.research provides an optional trusted server-side publisher for an already authorized durable Task. The caller must authenticate and authorize the Task and Run before invoking the publisher. Browser and guest requests never choose a container, shell command, owner, host path, or output URL.

docs.title: Python API
docs.text:
from chattask.research import DockerOverleafBridge, ResearchPublisher

from chattask.research_compiler import IsolatedResearchCompiler
compiler = IsolatedResearchCompiler(docker_client, "<private-compiler-root>", "<operator-configured-container>")
bridge = DockerOverleafBridge(container_name="<operator-configured-container>", origin="https://<operator-configured-origin>", compiler=compiler)
publisher = ResearchPublisher(state_root="<private-state-directory>", bridge=bridge)
result = publisher.publish(task_id, run_id, {
    "main.tex": "<self-contained ctexart source with inline bibliography>",
    "references.bib": "<optional reusable bibliography mirror>",
}, request_id, expected_root_doc_id=None)
# result.receipt, result.pdf_bytes, result.source_zip_bytes
# bridge.project_url(result.receipt["project_id"])

publish is synchronous. await publisher.apublish(...) runs it in a worker thread. A test may supply a synchronous or asynchronous callable bridge(payload) -> native_result; such test results are synthetic and are not live-service evidence. research_instructions(topic, source_records, followup=False) builds a host-neutral Codex Task prompt from caller-provided verified records. It does not fetch or discover sources. Records require canonical id, url, title, and content (or excerpt), and accept retrieved_at/read_scope or accessed_at/read_boundary. Evidence is explicitly marked when truncated; output stays within the Task's 16,000-character instruction cap. It asks for absolute /workspace/result/research/main.tex, /workspace/result/research/references.bib, /workspace/result/research/report.md, and /workspace/result/research/sources.json paths.

Each Task gets one private native project with a deterministic name and a task binding marker. Each Run adds flat documents prefixed r_<run-id>_; existing document content must match exactly on retry. The root pointer changes only when the prior managed root matches the native value. A pending operation is reconciled through the original service's current DocumentUpdater readback before another compile. Successful receipts and bytes are immutable in the private journal. Only current original-service document contents are archived into the source ZIP, so its provenance is original-service current document readback reconstructed as ZIP, not an HTTP project ZIP download.

The native helper runs inside the existing service container through a fixed docker exec argv and packaged static Node source. JSON requests go through stdin. It selects exactly one admin user using the service's configured admin email and existing isAdmin flag. This is administrative scripting under the operator boundary, not a browser login. It uses native project creation and document update handlers and a conditional root metadata update. Its publish_source action reads back exact current documents and never invokes the original service compiler. No sharing token is created or returned. The trusted bridge constructs a validated project link from the operator origin and native project id; its receipt includes project_url. The helper has a 13-minute self-expiring deadline. The Python Docker client waits at most 14 minutes without sending kill/terminate; an outer timeout keeps the operation pending with the host Docker client PID for supervisor reconciliation.

Before native writes, the worker resolves the configured original container's immutable image ID and public TeX toolchain bind from local Docker metadata. After verified source readback, IsolatedResearchCompiler uses a fresh Run-labelled container with that image, read-only manuscript/toolchain mounts and one private per-build PDF export directory, no original app data, no network, non-root identity, a read-only root filesystem, dropped capabilities, a cleared process environment, bounded resources, and bounded tmpfs output. It runs fixed xelatex arguments twice with shell escape disabled, retrieves only a bounded valid PDF, and removes the exact owned container. Uncertain cleanup leaves the Run blocked for operator reconciliation. The receipt includes isolated image and build provenance; no host path or credential is returned.

docs.title: Integration checklist
docs.text:
1. Ensure the installed wheel includes overleaf_native.mjs and the compiler module.
  2. Keep bridge configuration in trusted server settings. If unconfigured, skip Research publishing and let ordinary Tasks work normally.
  3. Authorize the caller's Task and Run in the existing durable Task API before invoking publish. Bind a stable request id and the last managed root id to the Run. Do not treat a caller-supplied owner id as authentication.
  4. Persist returned PDF and source ZIP as Task artifacts with the receipt and their hashes. A pending/unknown result must stay pending for reconciliation; do not report success from submitted bytes.
  5. Exercise two real rounds on the original service through the supervisor, including an external root change conflict. This lane has no live-service acceptance result.

The first slice accepts at most 20 flat text files (.tex, .bib, .md, .json), 1 MiB each and 4 MiB total. main.tex must be a self-contained ctexart document; external TeX inputs, images, and arbitrary asset remapping are unsupported. Source records and uncertainty belong in the Task's research outputs. A PDF receipt requires a successful isolated xelatex build and a valid bounded PDF extracted from that container.

The first-slice TeX validator in both Python and the trusted native helper accepts only the commands used by the verified two-round manuscripts: author, begin/end, bibitem, cite, date, documentclass, emph, hline, item, maketitle, section/subsection, setlength for tabcolsep, small, texttt, title, url, usepackage, escaped underscore, and linebreak. It accepts only ctexart, geometry/url/longtable packages, and document/abstract/enumerate/thebibliography/longtable environments. It rejects unknown macros, raw comments, ^^, unbalanced braces/environments, unsafe URLs and arbitrary package options. This allowlist reduces the accepted manuscript surface; it is not proof of complete TeX engine isolation. The supervisor must keep compiler isolation and the service's private configuration under separate review.

After an ambiguous native operation, a retry of the same Run is blocked while the exact Docker client process (PID plus boot/start identity) may still be running. A normal framed helper exit or the 13-minute native deadline plus bounded grace, followed by exact current document and root readback, is required before another publish helper starts. Missing /proc evidence or ambiguous readback keeps the private journal pending. The bridge never sends process signals. A PID in the journal is a host Docker client PID, not proof that remote writes did or did not occur.

docs.title: Task package lifecycle (unreleased candidate)
docs.text:
A Task owns its definition from creation, not just a ZIP assembled afterward. task.toml uses the Harbor 1.4 structure with purpose, deliverables, acceptance and template/resource declarations under the metadata.chatarch extension. This adapter supports a bounded subset, not every Harbor environment or Agent plugin, and does not automatically install Harbor/Rewardkit.

task.toml                         # Structured purpose, deliverables and criteria
instruction.md                    # Complete instructions for the solver
inputs/                           # Parameters, sources and resource references, no credentials
environment/skills/<name>/SKILL.md # Optional task-scoped method, not a global grant
tests/test.sh                     # Independent verifier entrypoint in a new Sandbox
tests/checks.py                    # Programmatic checks when required
tests/quality.toml                 # Optional model rubric
tests/judge-guide.md               # Optional judge guidance

Natural-language Tasks start with a pending definition. The Agent prepares checks/rubrics; the server freezes the definition before solving. Imported complete definitions skip preparation. Execution, independent verification and human acceptance are distinct: missing criteria, verifier errors, unavailable reviews and unknown cleanup never pass. Required failures cannot be averaged away. CAS revisions create new definitions without rewriting old Run snapshots.

Private round exports preserve the frozen definition, observed native events/ATIF, deliverables, reward/details and explicit review. Native checkpoints remain private to continuation and are excluded from reusable exports. Reuse creates a new Task without another instance's account, checkpoint, score or grants. Failed rounds remain evidence; the library is not a public dataset. ATIF is an exchange format, not a native session checkpoint.

The default Task view provides bounded text-file import, definition editing/cancel/revision, library search, reuse, downloads and explicit human review. Importable APIs live in DurableTaskService, TaskTemplateService and PackageService; consult the actual chattask --tree for commands:

chattask task package init ./example-task 'Build a tested utility' --image '<operator-image>'
chattask task package validate ./example-task
chattask task create --definition-dir ./example-task --image-profile python-package \
  --request-id example-create --owner operator --env-profile site

validate --official additionally requires the pinned Harbor 0.25.0 schema already installed. Default validation honestly reports official_schema_checked=false and executes no task. Imports allow at most 64 UTF-8 files/256 KiB and no symlink traversal. HTTP body limits are enforced separately.

Route Contract GET /api/task-templates Fixed templates, explicit revisions and parameter contracts POST /api/task-templates/{id}/instantiate request_id, template_revision, parameters; general templates also select registered image_profile GET /api/task-resources Configuration presence, not reachability or secret values GET /api/task-library Visible general/Python release Tasks, at most 100 items GET/PUT /api/durable/tasks/{id}/package Read definition or save files with stable request_id and expected_revision GET /api/durable/tasks/{id}/package.zip Definition ZIP with optional revision POST /api/durable/tasks/{id}/reuse New private Task without inherited success POST /api/durable/tasks/{id}/runs/{run}/evaluate Durable evaluation queue; HTTP never executes submitted scripts GET /api/durable/tasks/{id}/runs/{run}/evaluations That exact round's evaluation history POST /api/durable/tasks/{id}/review Explicit request_id, run_id, expected_revision, decision, criterion evidence and notes

The independent verifier starts a new Sandbox from the frozen definition and exact round outputs. Operators must provision required Python/Rewardkit/supported Codex judge dependencies. Missing dependencies or unavailable upstreams are verification errors, not evidence that content passed or failed. A configured model/image/gateway reference does not prove live availability.

docs.title: Conversation submission
docs.text:
An Agent can call authenticated POST /api/task-intake or use the thin HTTP client:

chattask task submit 'Build a tested utility with explicit deliverables' --request-id message-unique-id --env-profile site

The named profile supplies the existing site origin and login server-side. The API derives ownership from that login, selects the only configured image or requires an explicit --image-profile, and returns task_id, status and an exact authenticated url. Reuse the same message-derived request ID and payload after an uncertain response; do not create a second task blindly. Templates accept --template research-report|python-package --parameters-file parameters.json. Python publication creates a draft only: submission is not release approval. Trusted local task create --owner ... remains an operator surface, not remote authentication.

docs.title: Python publication is a Task
docs.text:
Saving python-package@1 parameters creates a package without dispatching publication. Model, environment, exact repository, OIDC Publisher and package-index resources remain references; server-side services issue existing constrained capabilities per stage. Established projects reuse their unchanged publishing chain instead of reopening PyPI login/Publisher setup.

The original PackageService still owns read-only preparation → exact target/plan confirmation → scoped publication → independent readback. Each stage binds a native task ID, draft revision and definition digest. Parameter changes invalidate old previews without overwriting old definitions. Under /api/package/drafts/{id}/, task-package and task-package.zip read/export definitions; task-data.zip includes versioned definitions, observed stage state, trusted validation/publication receipts and digest references to other artifacts. It does not automatically copy arbitrary workspaces or native sessions. Machine publication verification is not human business acceptance.

This adds no second publishing engine. Selecting a template or providing resources grants no push, PR, merge, tag, upload or production-restart permission. Candidate functionality and published/live versions require separate acceptance.

docs.title: Long-term Task candidate
docs.text:
Long-term Tasks are separate from one-shot chattask run. POST /api/durable/tasks accepts request_id, instructions and image_profile; the authenticated principal becomes owner. GET /api/durable/tasks, /{id} and /{id}/runs return private history. POST /{id}/resume accepts a new request_id, instructions and optional acknowledge_unknown=true; POST /{id}/pause and /{id}/complete accept request_id. Owner-only POST /{id}/members grants a named principal viewer or editor. GET /{id}/runs/{run_id}/artifacts/{name} checks access and SHA256. These paths all start with /api/durable/tasks, and writes use the existing site CSRF protection. Equal repeated request IDs return the same result; changed input conflicts. An active round cannot be resumed again.

Creation defaults to workflow=development. Research either sets workflow=research with 1–12 caller-verified source_records, or uses authenticated POST /api/durable/research/auto with request_id, instructions, image_profile, plain-text query and optional max_results (1–5). The latter retrieves and persists real arXiv Atom abstracts on the Task. This is abstract-only discovery; it does not imply full-paper reading or relevance review. Later rounds can supply new records or inherit the prior set. The model must write /workspace/result/research/main.tex as self-contained ctexart/xelatex with inline bibliography; references.bib, report and source metadata may accompany it. The trusted worker reads only that round's result archive and never accepts browser-selected container, project, user, path or command. ResearchPublisher binds the original Overleaf project to the Task; actual PDF and source readback become research.pdf and research-source.zip on the same Run, with native receipt and project link. Compile, sync and conflict failures stay blocked. After inspecting an unknown external outcome, POST /{id}/reconcile-research with a new request_id and acknowledge_unknown=true enqueues same-Run publication reconciliation without rerunning Codex.

The bridge is enabled only when both CHATTASK_RESEARCH_OVERLEAF_CONTAINER and HTTPS CHATTASK_RESEARCH_OVERLEAF_ORIGIN are configured. Development tasks need neither. Optional sensitive CHATTASK_LOGIN_USERS_JSON contains at most eight records with username, password, principal_id, display_name, verified by shared ChatLogin. The original site-operator username/password and site-operator principal remain; principal IDs must be unique. Do not add test accounts to production. Operators supply configuration, never browsers.

Web only enqueues. Run chattask worker --env-profile site --operator operator independently, with --once to process at most one round. Trusted local CLI uses chattask task create/list/show/resume/pause/complete with explicit --owner and --env-profile. The worker needs the existing model gateway, OpenSandbox and registered image. One process holds a native flock; after a worker crash, an active round becomes interrupted and possible external writes require inspection. The queue never replays it automatically. Web restart does not cancel the worker.

Each new Sandbox round checkpoints bounded /workspace/work, /workspace/result and $CODEX_HOME/sessions; links, traversal, special files, secret-looking paths, excess content and known short-lived credentials are rejected. A successful round requires native session ID, turn.completed, a verified checkpoint, container cleanup and gateway lease closure. A later round uses exact-session codex exec resume after checking supported flags in the guest. Pause is cooperative at the round boundary: queued work can pause before start, running work finishes its round first. Failed or interrupted rounds require explicit inspection; an initial failure without a checkpoint remains blocked. Production readiness is established only by the deployed image, gateway, original service and browser acceptance.

  • Task: instructions, acceptance criteria, stable request identity and a registered image profile. A verified prior result can be selected as input.
  • Executor: Codex works in a real Sandbox, not in the host source environment.
  • Image: supplies Codex, its companion binaries, Python, a shell and task-specific infrastructure.
  • Result: final text, native events, hashed output files and independent cleanup evidence. Package publishing is an example task, not the engine's fixed workflow.

docs.title: Configuration boundary
docs.text:
The ChatTask ChatEnv provider defines CHATTASK_CODEX_BASE_URL, sensitive CHATTASK_CODEX_API_KEY, CHATTASK_CODEX_MODEL, CHATTASK_CODEX_IMAGES, and the optional pair CHATTASK_CODEX_TOOLS_URL / sensitive CHATTASK_CODEX_TOOLS_TOKEN. Model and tool credentials are separate; a model key is not a tool token. Images use a JSON profile mapping such as {"python-package":"<operator-provisioned-image>"}. The browser can select only registered profile IDs.

Never bake credentials into an image. Runtime command environments inject the Codex access credential. Guest programs can still read that environment, so prefer a short-lived, constrained model/tool gateway credential. Keep GitHub PATs, PyPI passwords, sessions, TOTP secrets and upload keys on their respective trusted tool services. Task input cannot select host paths, raw credentials, arbitrary provider URLs or arbitrary images.

The current image contract includes codex, the companion tool host required by that Codex version, Python 3 and sh. Add Git, compilers, ChatPyPI or other infrastructure according to the task. A package image does not make Python packaging mandatory for generic tasks. Ordinary Docker/runc is a trusted-user isolation boundary, not strong isolation for hostile multi-tenancy.

docs.title: CLI entry
docs.text:
chattask run --instructions-file task.txt \
  --image-profile python-package --request-id task-001 \
  --env-profile site --json-output

The same request ID and input reconcile to the existing task. Changed input under that ID is rejected. --input-task-id accepts only the same owner's existing digest-verified result archive. CLI calls reuse chattask.agent_tasks.run_task; Web and HTTP share AgentTaskService and CodexTaskExecutor.

docs.title: HTTP entry
docs.text:
Route Operation GET /api/agent/images List configured image profiles POST /api/agent/tasks Submit request_id, instructions, image_profile, optional input_task_id GET /api/agent/tasks Current owner's tasks GET /api/agent/tasks/{id} Status, result, steps, runtime and cleanup evidence POST /api/agent/tasks/{id}/cancel Request cooperative cancellation GET /api/agent/tasks/{id}/artifacts/{name} Digest-checked output download

Routes reuse the host's login and CSRF boundary without exposing model/tool credentials. Closing the browser does not cancel an accepted server-side task.

docs.title: State and acceptance
docs.text:
queued → running → completed, blocked or interrupted. A completed execution means the native Codex turn finished, outputs were collected and the Sandbox was removed. It is not independent proof of an external publication. A release task additionally needs real repository, Publisher, merged tag, OIDC upload, registry and clean-install evidence.

The default Codex command budget is 900 seconds; Sandbox lifetime includes cleanup headroom and must be allowed by the control plane. Existing per-Sandbox limits remain 1 CPU, 512 MiB, 128 PIDs, no host mounts and loopback data ports. Failed turns preserve redacted native events when available. Uncertain external writes are never replayed automatically.

docs.title: Python package template (candidate source)
docs.text:
The Python package card uses the same versioned, channel-neutral schema as GET /api/package/schema. A one-sentence request prefills only an obvious mode and name. The user provides the module, CLI, owner/repository, description and explicit requirements. The defaults are a private repository, MIT, Python >=3.10, bilingual MkDocs and standard CI/OIDC. Literal names are preserved and checked before remote lookup; normalized collisions block preparation.

Owner-bound drafts support create, edit, prepare and confirm through /api/package/drafts routes. Every mutation uses a stable request ID. Editing increments the revision and invalidates the old preview. Preparation runs a read-only scoped Codex Sandbox task and produces a bounded package-plan archive. A trusted Sandbox script runs tests and builds wheel/sdist; the server verifies the archive, source manifests, metadata and a separate attestation before showing an exact confirmation phrase. Confirmation starts a second task with only the approved target, source and artifact digests, and action list. Task completion alone is not a publication claim; external receipts and clean installation still need inspection.

Package preparation and submission require an optional HTTPS broker configured with CHATTASK_GATEWAY_URL and sensitive CHATTASK_GATEWAY_CLIENT_TOKEN. Generic tasks retain their legacy runtime option. The broker returns fresh per-task model and tool access, while upstream provider credentials remain on trusted services. CHATTASK_CODEX_HOSTS is an operator-owned hostname-to-IP JSON mapping applied only inside a guest, when required. The CLI exposes package schema, plan, draft-create, draft-show, prepare and confirm. CLI drafts have an operator owner separate from web drafts.

Feishu button cards may link to this site's authenticated form for text input. This package does not implement Feishu transport or native card text callbacks. Deployment and external publication verification remain separate from these source interfaces.

The gateway response must bind id to the exact task ID and model_base_url to /sessions//v1; package tools use the matching session root, while generic tasks receive none. Optional CHATTASK_GATEWAY_CA_FILE points to an operator-owned absolute public PEM CA (up to 64 KiB). The controller extends default trust, and the Sandbox appends the CA to its system bundle for Codex, Python and Requests. No controller token or CA private key enters the Sandbox.

Preparation permits at most 100 source files per branch, 200000 bytes per file, and 2000000 bytes per branch. After native Codex completion, trusted publication validation checks the exact approved plan digest, scoped release source/PR/merge/CI/tag and actual Publish-to-PyPI job/step receipts, PyPI JSON and wheel/sdist file hashes, and a clean install in a fresh Sandbox venv with CLI --version and --tree. Missing evidence blocks the task; evidence is saved in trusted-publication.json and install logs. The scoped status response must expose repository, branches (release SHA, manifest digest and base SHA; main SHA and manifest digest), pull_request, ci.release / ci.main, tag, and publish (workflow/head SHA, job/step names, conclusions, and actual publish action) from provider receipts.

Publication validation reads the exact release JSON through scoped GET /pypi/api/release and, for new projects only, the 0.0.1 placeholder through GET /pypi/api/placeholder. It fetches each official distribution by its SHA256 through scoped GET /pypi/api/artifacts/{sha256} (10 MiB per file), hashes the bytes again, and installs the verified target wheel. The gateway must restrict these fixed read-only routes to the approved project, version and official file digests. With the existing pinned CHATTASK_PUBLIC_DEPS_PATH and CHATTASK_PUBLIC_DEPS_SHA256 archive, validation extracts only deps/wheelhouse/*.whl into a fresh directory and installs with --no-index --find-links. Already installed .py/.so files in the archive are not used as wheels; an empty or invalid wheelhouse blocks validation. Without an archive, dependency resolution explicitly uses the public index while still installing the verified target wheel. The trusted receipt records the dependency source and archive digest. Operators must provision a new pinned archive containing the original infrastructure files plus wheels.

docs.title: Read-only recheck after a submitted publication
docs.text: When the original publish task is terminal but its final readback failed, the draft page offers a read-only recheck. It creates a new trusted Sandbox validation task against the same approved preparation archive, source manifests, target, and version. It does not run Codex, upload again, create a PR, or tag. The original task status and error remain intact. The page shows the new result separately. A failed recheck requires an explicit new request ID; an uncertain response is reconciled with the same ID. The verify gateway session supplies only scoped read-only tools, no model access, and receives the original policy plus verification_of identifying the original publish task. Public registry and scoped status reads retry only transport timeouts or connection failures, at most twice; certificate, permission, target, and digest failures block immediately.

docs.title: Workspace material analysis
docs.text: Scenario Interface Boundary Read results Authenticated Task page, material-analysis tab Read-only; cannot start a Run Prepare work Trusted service creates an immutable draft Fixed material, revisions and digest Analyze Explicit confirmation of draft version and digest Real model request; no tools or host-file access

docs.title: Configuration
docs.text:
Set CHATTASK_WORKSPACE_KEY (32–512 UTF-8 bytes of server-side shared credential) and CHATTASK_ANALYSIS_PROFILE (an existing ChatEnv OpenAI profile name) in the existing ChatTask named profile. Model endpoint, key and model are read server-side from that existing profile, never copied into browser assets or source. Empty configuration disables integration authentication or model startup. Store service credentials only in approved private configuration, never URLs, frontend code, logs or Git.

This executor is separate from generic Codex + Sandbox tasks: it analyzes supplied context only, with no host tools, code execution or additional file access. It is not an automatic replacement model for Codex failures. The default complete-request deadline is 180 seconds, with separate connection, per-read and byte limits. Failures remain terminal records; no automatic replay or paid-provider fallback occurs.

docs.title: Service contract
docs.text:
Integration routes require a separate Bearer credential and a matching deployment Host. Any supplied Origin must match too. The service credential cannot sign into the website or read ordinary private APIs. Request bodies are limited to 65536 bytes.

Method Path Result GET /integrations/workspace/capabilities provided_materials_only scope and model-configuration state POST /integrations/workspace/tasks 201 for a new draft, 200 for a replay GET /integrations/workspace/tasks?actor=...&proposal_id=... Tasks for the bound actor and proposal GET /integrations/workspace/tasks/{task_id}?actor=... Immutable task and Run history POST /integrations/workspace/tasks/{task_id}/runs Start after explicit confirmation POST /integrations/workspace/tasks/{task_id}/runs/{run_id}/cancel Cancel the actor's Run GET /integrations/workspace/tasks/{task_id}/runs/{run_id}/report?actor=... Text, size and SHA256

A draft contains exactly actor, stable request_id, title, instructions, acceptance, source and context. The source identifies site_id=workspace-web, proposal_id, two 64-character lowercase hexadecimal revisions (catalog_revision, proposal_revision) and nonempty project_ids. Each context item contains id, title, kind (summary, document or code) and text; combined material is limited to 24000 characters. Trusted callers derive the actor from their authenticated subject rather than accepting a browser-supplied identity.

Starting a Run requires the same actor, a separately stable request ID, task_version, source_digest and literal confirmed=true. Replays do not execute twice; reusing a request ID with different content conflicts. Runs transition from queued to running, then succeeded, failed, cancelled or interrupted. Restart marks unfinished runs interrupted without replay. At most five runs are active and model execution is serialized.

docs.title: Result evidence
docs.text:
Only one active material-analysis controller may own a state directory. Startup recovery or the first execution acquires a process-shared exclusive lock; another controller refuses execution, cancellation and recovery rather than interrupting live Runs. shutdown() waits for owned jobs before releasing the lock, and process exit releases it too. Python callers should call shutdown() in finally. Reading saved reports does not require execution ownership.

report.md binds Task, proposal, revisions, material digest and actual model. Reading independently rechecks size and SHA256; only a semantically complete model response succeeds. A completed report proves analysis of the supplied material, not completion of the original proposal, deployment or release.

The existing site account can open /?workspace_task=<32-character Task ID> and return to that task after login to read its Runs and reports. /api/workspace-tasks and its detail/report routes retain ChatLogin authentication; a service key is not a browser session. The browser only reads existing tasks. Transient failures retain the previous report with a stale/error message; authentication loss clears protected views. The single-user operator view is not a multi-tenant authorization system.

Python callers use chattask.workspace_analysis.WorkspaceAnalysis and its create_task, create_run, get_task, report, cancel, recover and shutdown methods. The registered CLI tree is unchanged; no plan-only command is added.
